For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The isdn4k-utils packages contain a collection of utilities required for configuring an Integrated Services Digital Network (ISDN) subsystem.

The isdn4k-utils packages have been updated to ensure correct operation on Power little endian and ARM 64-bit hardware architectures. (BZ#1060370)

This update fixes the following bug:

* Manual pages for the following isdn4k-utils binaries were previously missing: /usr/bin/capifax, /usr/bin/capifaxrcvd, /usr/bin/vboxcnvt, and /usr/sbin/rcapid. With this update, the manual pages have been added to isdn4k-utils. (BZ#948944)

Users of isdn4k-utils are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix this bug.
